generation.desc.depth_first: Controls corridor shape: low values give short, winding passages; high values give long, straight corridors.
generation.desc.corridor_chance: Controls how often passages are narrow corridors versus open junctions with multiple branches.
generation.desc.branching: Controls how wide junctions are. Low values keep junctions simple; high values create wider junctions with more branches.
generation.desc.directionality: Controls how often the maze continues straight ahead instead of turning, making corridors feel more linear.
generation.desc.cyclicity: Controls how often extra connections are added that create loops in the maze, instead of a single branching path.
generation.desc.corridor_length: Controls how long corridors tend to be before the maze branches off in a new direction.
generation.canonical_elements_warning: Canonical algorithm: adds only plain passages. One-way, teleports etc. can be achieved with rules in the {qualityTitle} section.

algorithm.desc.custom_vertex_based: A configurable algorithm that builds mazes by traversing vertices. Supports depth-first exploration, corridor chance, branching factor, and directional bias. Produces a wide variety of maze styles depending on parameters.
algorithm.desc.custom_edge_based: A configurable algorithm that operates on edges rather than vertices. Controls corridor length, branching, locality (how clustered the passages are), and directionality. Good for producing organic-looking mazes.
algorithm.desc.recursive_backtracker: Classic depth-first search maze generator. Produces mazes with long winding corridors and low branching. Guaranteed perfect maze (single solution). No configurable parameters.
algorithm.desc.wilson_algorithm: Generates a uniformly random spanning tree using loop-erased random walks. Every possible perfect maze is equally likely. Slower on large fields but produces statistically unbiased results. No configurable parameters.
algorithm.desc.kruskal_algorithm: Generates a minimum spanning tree by randomly merging disjoint sets. Produces mazes with many short passages and high branching. No configurable parameters.

check.missing_endpoints.label: Start and finish present
check.missing_endpoints.description: Fires if the maze has no start or no finish.
check.unreachable_finish.label: Finish reachable from start
check.unreachable_finish.description: Fires if finish cannot be reached from start via directed traversal.
check.min_loops_count.label: Min loop count
check.min_loops_count.description: Fires if the maze has fewer independent loops than the required minimum.
check.min_loop_density.label: Min loop density
check.min_loop_density.description: Fires if too small a share of the field is covered by loops. The coverage deficit is converted into a loop count via an estimated average loop length.
check.loop_length.label: Loop length
check.loop_length.description: Fires if a loop's tile length compares against the configured threshold (e.g. shorter or longer than a limit).
check.external_escape_diversity.label: Exit count
check.external_escape_diversity.descript: Fires if a loop has too few exits to the rest of the maze. Exits leading to the same place outside the loop count as one.
check.loop_distance_from_start.label: Distance from start
check.loop_distance_from_start.descripti: Fires if a loop sits closer to start (in tiles, directed graph distance) than the required minimum.
check.loop_distance_from_finish.label: Distance from finish
check.loop_distance_from_finish.descript: Fires if a loop sits closer to finish (in tiles, directed graph distance) than the required minimum.
check.max_loop_density.label: Max density
check.max_loop_density.description: Fires if too large a share of the field is covered by loops. Every loop is flagged when the maximum is exceeded.
check.max_loops_count.label: Max loop count
check.max_loops_count.description: Fires if the field has more simple loops than allowed. Every loop is flagged when the maximum is exceeded.
check.scc_count.label: Max SCC count
check.scc_count.description: Fires if the graph is split into more strongly-connected regions than the allowed maximum, signalling a fragmented maze.
check.min_region_size.label: Min SCC size
check.min_region_size.description: Fires if any strongly-connected region has fewer tiles than the required minimum.
check.min_region_ratio.label: Min SCC ratio
check.min_region_ratio.description: Fires if any strongly-connected region covers less than the required share of the field.
check.max_region_size.label: Max SCC size
check.max_region_size.description: Fires if any strongly-connected region has more tiles than the allowed maximum.
check.max_region_ratio.label: Max SCC ratio
check.max_region_ratio.description: Fires if any strongly-connected region covers more than the allowed share of the field.
check.min_region_count.label: Min count
check.min_region_count.description: Fires if the maze has fewer regions of any class than the required minimum (or more — used during repair as available surplus).
check.teleport_duplicates_connection.des: Fires if a teleport duplicates a regular connection already present between the same pair of tiles in the same direction.
check.teleport_waypoint_distance.label: Waypoint distance
check.teleport_waypoint_distance.descrip: Fires if a teleport's entry (or entry/exit) sits closer than the required minimum logical distance to start and/or finish.
check.teleport_geometric_length.label: Geometric length
check.teleport_geometric_length.descript: Fires if the geometric (straight-line) distance between a teleport's entry and exit compares against the configured threshold.
check.teleport_super_hub_avoidance.label: Super-hub avoidance
check.teleport_super_hub_avoidance.descr: Fires if a teleport's entry (or exit, or either) vertex already has more than the allowed number of outgoing connections.
check.teleport_group_proximity.label: Group proximity
check.teleport_group_proximity.descripti: Fires if a pair of teleport edges sit topologically closer to each other than the required minimum distance.
param.min_loops.label: Min loop count
param.min_loops.description: The minimum number of loops the maze must contain.
param.length.label: Length threshold
param.length.description: The tile-length (or geometric distance) threshold this check's comparison operator applies against.
param.comparison.label: Comparison
param.comparison.description: The condition that fails the check: how the measured value must relate to the threshold for the check to report an issue.
param.min_distinct_exits.label: Min exits
param.min_distinct_exits.description: The minimum number of distinct places a loop must connect to outside itself.
param.min_distance_from_start.label: Min distance from start
param.min_distance_from_start.descriptio: How far (in tiles) a loop must be from the start before it's allowed.
param.min_distance_from_finish.label: Min distance from finish
param.min_distance_from_finish.descripti: How far (in tiles) a loop must be from the finish before it's allowed.
param.max_density.label: Max loop density (per 100 cells)
param.max_density.description: The maximum share of the maze that loops are allowed to cover.
param.max_loops_count.label: Max loop count
param.max_loops_count.description: The maximum number of simple loops allowed in the maze.
param.min_density.label: Min loop density (per 100 cells)
param.min_density.description: The minimum share of the maze that loops must cover.
param.avg_loop_length_estimate.label: Average loop length estimate
param.avg_loop_length_estimate.descripti: An estimate of typical loop size, used to figure out how many loops are needed to reach the target density.
param.path_weight.label: Path length weight
param.path_weight.description: How much a longer path between start and finish counts against a candidate placement. Higher values favor shorter paths.
param.junction_weight.label: Junction weight
param.junction_weight.description: How much passing through junctions counts against a candidate placement. Higher values favor paths with fewer junctions.
param.oneway_weight.label: One-way passage weight
param.oneway_weight.description: How much passing through one-way passages counts against a candidate placement. Higher values favor paths that avoid one-way passages.
param.teleport_weight.label: Teleport weight
param.teleport_weight.description: How much crossing a teleport edge counts toward a candidate placement's score. Higher values favor paths that use teleports.
param.short_overlap_weight.label: Shared short-loop weight
param.short_overlap_weight.description: How strongly a cut is preferred when it also breaks other invalid loops sharing the same passage.
param.other_overlap_weight.label: Shared valid-loop penalty
param.other_overlap_weight.description: How strongly a cut is avoided when it would also break a valid loop sharing the same passage.
param.reserve_percent.label: Reserve percent
param.reserve_percent.description: Extra connection attempts added on top of the minimum needed, as a safety margin in case some attempts fail.
param.max_scc_count.label: Max SCC region count
param.max_scc_count.description: The maximum number of strongly-connected regions the graph is allowed to be split into.
param.min_region_size.label: Min region size (tiles)
param.min_region_size.description: The minimum number of tiles a strongly-connected region must contain.
param.min_region_ratio.label: Min region ratio (%)
param.min_region_ratio.description: The minimum share of the field (in %) a strongly-connected region must cover.
param.max_region_size.label: Max region size (tiles)
param.max_region_size.description: The maximum number of tiles a strongly-connected region may contain.
param.max_region_ratio.label: Max region ratio (%)
param.max_region_ratio.description: The maximum share of the field (in %) a strongly-connected region may cover.
param.locality.label: Growth directionality
param.locality.description: How directional region growth is: 0 expands uniformly in every direction, 1 prefers continuing straight from the previous step.
param.region_class.label: Region class
param.region_class.description: Which region class to count regions of.
param.region_class.option.alternative.ex: Can reach finish, but not on the shortest path
param.region_class.option.trap.explanati: Reachable from start, but cannot reach finish
param.path_count.label: Min Path region count
param.path_count.description: Minimum number of Path-class regions. 0 — don't check.
param.alternative_count.label: Min Alternative region count
param.alternative_count.description: Minimum number of Alternative-class regions. 0 — don't check.
param.unreachable_count.label: Min Unreachable region count
param.unreachable_count.description: Minimum number of Unreachable-class regions. 0 — don't check.
param.trap_count.label: Min Trap region count
param.trap_count.description: Minimum number of Trap-class regions. 0 — don't check.
param.target_mode.label: Target selection mode
param.target_mode.description: How to pick which neighboring region to merge the undersized region into.
param.target_mode.option.largest.explana: Merges into the biggest neighboring region.
param.target_mode.option.smallest.explan: Merges into the smallest neighboring region.
param.target_mode.option.random.explanat: Merges into any neighboring region, picked at random.
param.target_mode.option.prefer_needy.ex: Prefers a neighboring region that is also undersized; falls back to a random neighbor if none are.
param.connection_mode.label: Connection mode
param.connection_mode.description: How to bridge the undersized region into its neighbor.
param.connection_mode.option.passage.exp: Adds a full bidirectional passage across a shared wall.
param.connection_mode.option.one_way.exp: Adds two separate one-way edges (in and out) through different walls instead of a single passage.
param.prefer_partially_connected.label: Prefer partially connected neighbors
param.prefer_partially_connected.descrip: When choosing a neighboring region, prefer one that already has a one-way edge to or from the flagged region — completing it instead of starting a fresh connection elsewhere.
param.direction_mode.label: Teleport direction mode
param.direction_mode.description: How to cover both directions between the region and its chosen neighbor.
param.direction_mode.option.two_way.expl: A single matched two-way teleport pair covers both directions.
param.direction_mode.option.one_way.expl: Two separate one-way teleports, each through its own pair of endpoints, cover the two directions.
param.min_distance.label: Minimum endpoint distance
param.min_distance.description: Minimum logical distance a freshly-picked teleport endpoint must keep from an already-occupied endpoint in the same region.

strategy.experimental_warning: This is an experimental strategy — its results and performance may be unpredictable.
strategy.no_fix.label: Logging
strategy.no_fix.description: Records the issue in the report without attempting to fix it. This is the base behavior — it's what happens automatically whenever a rule's fix strategy is disabled, so it can't be disabled itself.
strategy.random_endpoints.label: Random endpoints
strategy.random_endpoints.description: Places start and finish at random nodes in the maze.
strategy.farthest_endpoints.label: Farthest endpoints
strategy.farthest_endpoints.description: Places start and finish at two nodes with a large path distance between them. Uses a fast heuristic (double path-search sweep) rather than an exhaustive search over all pairs — on graphs with cycles it can pick a pair slightly short of the true maximum.
strategy.scored_endpoints.label: Scored endpoints
strategy.scored_endpoints.description: Scores all candidate endpoint pairs by path length, junction count and one-way passage count, then picks the best pair.
strategy.invalid_loop_random.label: Break loop randomly
strategy.invalid_loop_random.description: Breaks each invalid loop by removing one random passage from it.
strategy.invalid_loop_scored.label: Break loop by overlap score
strategy.invalid_loop_scored.description: Breaks each invalid loop by removing the passage that overlaps the most other invalid loops while overlapping the fewest valid loops.
strategy.invalid_loop_group_select.label: Select and break one loop
strategy.invalid_loop_group_select.descr: Picks one flagged loop (at random, or the shortest/longest) and delegates breaking it to a nested loop-breaking strategy.
strategy.missing_loops_random.label: Seed loops randomly
strategy.missing_loops_random.descriptio: Adds random bidirectional passages (with a configurable reserve margin) and lets the next quality control pass discard the ones that don't form a valid loop.
strategy.expand_region_passage.label: Expand region with a passage
strategy.expand_region_passage.descripti: Merges an undersized region into a neighboring region by adding a full bidirectional passage across a shared wall.
strategy.teleport_region_merge.label: Expand region with a teleport
strategy.teleport_region_merge.descripti: Merges an undersized region into a neighboring region via a teleport edge — the two regions don't need to be geometrically adjacent.
strategy.missing_regions.label: Grow or reuse missing regions
strategy.missing_regions.description: Reuses an existing region or grows a new one from a seed, then converts it into the needed region class by adding or removing one-way passages.
strategy.reduce_scc_count.label: Merge regions to reduce count
strategy.reduce_scc_count.description: Picks the regions to merge (by size or at random) until the region count reaches the configured maximum, then delegates the actual merge to a nested strategy.
strategy.remove_teleport.label: Remove teleport
strategy.remove_teleport.description: Removes each teleport edge flagged invalid by a per-teleport validation check.
strategy.weighted_region_merge.label: Weighted random region merge
strategy.weighted_region_merge.descripti: Picks one of several nested region-merge strategies at random, weighted by each one's configured weight; if the chosen one fails, retries a different one (still weighted) until one succeeds or every candidate has been tried.
strategy.teleport_group_proximity.label: Remove one of each close pair
strategy.teleport_group_proximity.descri: For each pair of teleports flagged too close to each other, removes one of the two.
param.selection_mode.label: Target loop selection
param.selection_mode.description: Which flagged loop to pick for breaking.
param.selection_mode.option.shortest.exp: Picks the flagged loop with the fewest passages.
param.selection_mode.option.longest.expl: Picks the flagged loop with the most passages.
param.sample_mode.label: Sample size mode
param.sample_mode.description: Whether the sample size below is an absolute count or a percentage of flagged loops.
param.sample_mode.option.count.explanati: Sample size is an absolute number of loops.
param.sample_mode.option.percent.explana: Sample size is a percentage of all flagged loops.
param.sample_size.label: Sample size
param.sample_size.description: How many flagged loops to resolve per repair pass — an absolute count or a percentage, per the sample size mode. Always at least 1.
param.merge_priority.label: Merge priority
param.merge_priority.description: Which regions to pick for merging first.
param.distance.label: Min distance
param.distance.description: Minimum logical (tile) distance the matching teleport edge(s) must keep from the matching waypoint(s).
param.waypoint.label: Waypoint
param.waypoint.description: Which waypoint(s) the distance is measured against.
param.waypoint.option.start.explanation: Measures distance from the maze's start only.
param.waypoint.option.finish.explanation: Measures distance from the maze's finish only.
param.waypoint.option.any.explanation: Uses whichever of start or finish is closer.
param.edge.label: Edge
param.edge.description: Which end(s) of the teleport the distance is measured from.
param.edge.option.entry_only.explanation: Only the teleport's entry point is checked.
param.edge.option.entry_or_exit.explanat: The teleport is flagged if either its entry or its exit is too close.
param.edge_hub.label: Edge
param.edge_hub.description: Which end(s) of the teleport's vertex is checked for an excessive outgoing-connection count.
param.edge_hub.option.entry.explanation: Only the teleport's entry vertex is checked.
param.edge_hub.option.exit.explanation: Only the teleport's exit vertex is checked.
param.edge_hub.option.entry_or_exit.expl: The teleport is flagged if either its entry or its exit vertex exceeds the max connection count.
param.own_edge.label: This teleport's end
param.own_edge.description: Which end of the teleport being scanned is measured.
param.own_edge.option.entry.explanation: Measures from the teleport's entry point.
param.own_edge.option.exit.explanation: Measures from the teleport's exit point.
param.own_edge.option.entry_or_exit.expl: Uses whichever of the teleport's entry or exit is closer.
param.other_edge.label: Other teleport's end
param.other_edge.description: Which end of the other teleport in the pair is measured.
param.other_edge.option.entry.explanatio: Measures against the other teleport's entry point.
param.other_edge.option.exit.explanation: Measures against the other teleport's exit point.
param.other_edge.option.entry_or_exit.ex: Uses whichever of the other teleport's entry or exit is closer.
param.priority.label: Removal priority
param.priority.description: Which teleport of a problematic pair to remove.
param.protect_route.label: Protect route teleports
param.protect_route.description: Skip checking teleports that lie on the maze's start-finish route.
param.priority.option.random.explanation: Removes a random teleport from the pair.
param.priority.option.problematic.explan: Removes whichever teleport in the pair belongs to more other problematic pairs.
param.max_connections.label: Max connections
param.max_connections.description: Maximum number of outgoing connections allowed at the teleport's checked vertex before it's considered a super-hub.
